title: An agent build waits for its research, keeps the template's showcase pages as the business's, runs its five checks to the end (no loop notice telling it to stop, no check spent on nothing changed, no write refused in a turn its host reopened), and the customer's road is whole: start card, research progress, a reload that comes back, a suggestion with its picture and its trade
steps: S1: POST /:id/demo/build with workflow agent-demo/1 while the research is absent, then paused.
S2: compareAgentInventory with an empty editorial field filled.
S3: compareAgentInventory with a WordPress showcase page and its menu entry renamed and readdressed; then removed.
S4: compareAgentInventory with a Joomla showcase menu item renamed; then unpublished.
S5: compareAgentInventory with an EmDash relation title renamed, a key/value label rewritten and the menu written again with new ids; then one menu item fewer.
S6: checkNoDemoWords over a page still linking the template category Engineering, against a baseline that read it.
S7: isLogo on the brand logo, a file called logo and a photo.
S8: stepBudget over thirty photo imports and plan saves in a build; loopNotices of a build.
S9: changedSinceCheck after a check with nothing written; checkAgainNext with two checks run.
S10: createTurnBook: a turn closed at turn-stopping that a notice steers on; openTurn with steered on a closed row; markStale on a 45-minute build turn.
S11: autoTemplate for trade other with an agency template and a generic one; tradeOfWords('flour bakery').
S13: compareAgentInventory with an EmDash empty body filled, a rich-text body rewritten, a date and a Joomla contact link relabelled.
S14: refusalNext for a featured_image_id post field; reasonWords for cause built.
expect: S1: 409 RESEARCH_NOT_DONE both times, no action accepted.
S5: kept; the shorter menu fails.
S6: fails naming engineering and its /category/ link; a brief that names it passes.
S8: no step budget due; the build notice says to write the next plan row, never 'smallest change'.
S9: false (not sent); '3 of 5 checks remain'.
S10: the steered step re-sends turn with steered:true and the next stop closes it again; the row reads open; the build turn stays open, a chat turn goes stale.
S11: tracy-business, never Tracy Base; food.
S12: source, photos, minutes; the kept business is followed; picture, blurb and demo; origin business.
S13: structure kept for each; a removed link still fails.
S14: the next names postmeta _thumbnail_id; the sentence says the request built the site.
fence: research gate of the agent build; showcaseOf/maskShowcase; EmDash menu positions and relationCopy; no-demo-words labels

tests: an agent build waits for its research: none or a paused one is refused, nothing accepted
an empty editorial field the build fills keeps the structure; a technical one changed does not
a showcase page and its menu entry may be renamed and readdressed; removing one or moving another still fails
a Joomla showcase menu item may be renamed; unpublishing it still fails
EmDash: a relation renamed, a label–value row relabelled and a menu written again keep the structure
no-demo-words: a category or tag the template named fails while the page still names it, unless the brief does
a logo is the brand's or a file called logo; a photo is not
stepBudget: a build importing photos, saving its plan or running a check is working; a refused one is not
loopNotices: a build is told to write its plan and keep checking, never to make the smallest change or stop
changedSinceCheck: a write or a photo after the latest verdict counts; another check or a refused write does not
a step steered into a turn already closed opens it again, and the turn’s next stop closes it again
a business of unknown trade gets a template made for no trade, never an agency’s; its own name tells its trade
researchProgressOf: the source being read, the photos saved and the minutes, from the job the state door answers
keptBusiness: a started business is kept for a day; forgetting it, a broken or throwing storage start afresh
suggestionCardOf: the suggested template’s picture, sentence and demo from the catalogue, each null when absent
EmDash: an empty body filled, a rich-text body rewritten and a date changed keep the structure
Joomla: a contact link relabelled keeps the structure; its address removed does not
the first turn of a whole-site build says it built the site, not that its start was not recorded
